witness.branch: Other motor vehicle relative to protected motorcycle
witness.quote: a person shall not drive another motor vehicle in a manner which would deprive any such motorcycle or moped of such use.
witness.reason: The control motorcycle can be a protected lane occupant distinct from ego.
